definitions.gloss: new bud, new sprout, young shoot
definitions.explanation: A newly emerging bud or shoot on a plant. Associated with spring and the start of new growth.

examples.english: New buds have started to appear on the tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{新芽|しんめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{芽吹|めぶ}く→芽吹く：13995_mebuku⟧。
examples.english: When spring comes, new buds sprout all at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新芽|しんめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摘|つ}んで→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧{新茶|しんちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: New tea buds are picked to make shincha (first-harvest tea).

notes:
{新芽|しんめ} refers to newly emerging buds or shoots on a plant. Strongly associated with spring and the image of renewal and fresh growth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新芽|しんめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: new buds emerge
- {新芽|しんめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽吹|めぶ}く→芽吹く：13995_mebuku⟧: new buds sprout
- {新芽|しんめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摘|つ}む→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧: to pick new buds
- {新芽|しんめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧: new shoots grow

TEA CONTEXT:
In the tea world, {新芽|しんめ} refers to the first tender leaves of the season, prized for producing {新茶|しんちゃ} (first-flush tea, harvested in spring).
